This includes managing agency interactions, overseeing data privacy frameworks, and ensuring organizational adherence to evolving regulatory and legislative standards.

title: Quality Engineer
ai_summary: The Quality Engineer manages supplier quality, nonconforming material, and complaint investigations to ensure product quality and regulatory compliance. They collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve quality issues, perform trend analysis, and support internal and external audits.

title: Senior Quality Systems Specialist
ai_summary: The specialist will develop, implement, and maintain the Business Unit’s Quality System, including document control, CAPA, and risk management processes. They are responsible for generating quality metrics, driving closure of nonconformances, and ensuring audit readiness.

title: Senior Director, Global Regulatory Lead
ai_summary: The Senior Director, Global Regulatory Lead provides strategic regulatory leadership for radiopharmaceutical clinical development programs and commercial launches. They are responsible for developing global regulatory strategies, leading major submissions, and serving as the primary regulatory advisor for cross-functional teams.

title: Laboratory Technician
ai_summary: The Laboratory Technician will maintain clean, organized, and fully functional lab spaces while managing inventory and safety standards. They will also perform equipment maintenance and prepare bio-hazardous waste for disposal.

title: Manager, GxP Document Control and Quality Systems
ai_summary: The Manager will lead document control operations and quality systems coordination, ensuring procedural content is accurate, consistent, and audit-ready. They will also manage GxP training programs, support vendor audits, and facilitate cross-functional document generation processes.

title: Associate Director, Clinical Quality Assurance
ai_summary: The Associate Director will oversee GCP-focused quality assurance for clinical trials to ensure compliance with global regulations and industry standards. They will lead audit strategies, manage inspection readiness, and drive process improvements across the organization.

title: Quality Release Specialist
ai_summary: The Quality Release Specialist supports the release process for raw materials, components, and finished products to ensure compliance with quality and schedule goals. They are responsible for maintaining organized batch records and staying informed on industry regulatory trends like FDA and cGMP.

title: Director, Global GCP QA
ai_summary: The Director, Global GCP QA is responsible for governance, compliance oversight, and strategic execution across clinical studies and vendor programs. This role leads audit strategies, ensures inspection readiness, and drives continuous improvement within the quality management system.

title: Laboratory Technician III
ai_summary: The Laboratory Technician III performs routine laboratory support tasks including sample handling, instrument maintenance, and hazardous waste monitoring. They must ensure all activities comply with cGMP regulations and maintain accurate documentation of laboratory data.

title: QA Inspector
ai_summary: The QA Inspector is responsible for inspecting incoming materials and finished goods against technical drawings and specifications. They must document results in quality databases and ensure all products comply with FDA and ISO regulatory standards.

title: Regulatory Affairs Specialist
ai_summary: The specialist executes regulatory strategies for product registration and life-cycle management of medical devices. Key duties include reviewing labeling, maintaining technical files, and ensuring compliance with FDA and international regulatory standards.

title: Quality Engineer
ai_summary: Ensures product verification, validation, and testing meet customer, industry, and regulatory requirements. Performs investigations, risk mitigation activities, and continuous improvement to resolve quality issues in manufacturing.

title: Quality Control Assistant
ai_summary: Perform analytical and wet chemistry activities to ensure product quality and integrity. Responsibilities include sampling raw materials, conducting chemical analyses, and maintaining laboratory instrumentation while documenting results.

title: Senior Manager, Clinical Quality Assurance
ai_summary: Lead global investigations and manage CAPA plans to ensure compliance with regulatory guidelines and SOPs. Conduct risk-based audits of clinical sites and vendors while supporting regulatory agency inspection readiness.

title: Laboratory Technician – Maintenance & Repair
ai_summary: The technician is responsible for the repair, maintenance, and upkeep of mechanical, electrical, and hydraulic testing equipment. This includes fabricating components using mills, lathes, and welding to support laboratory testing operations.

title: Laboratory Technician
ai_summary: The Lab Technician is responsible for the accurate execution of DNA library preparation and the operation of sequencing and liquid handling instruments. They also handle sample preparation, results analysis, and coordination with the global logistics team.

title: Regulatory Affairs Specialist (FDA medical device regulation) - REMOTE: Anywhere USA
ai_summary: Provide regulatory affairs support to ensure full compliance with U.S. FDA medical device requirements and ISO 13485 standards. Manage pre-market submissions, technical documentation for EU MDR, and oversee customer complaint reporting and corrective actions.

title: Senior Director, Regulatory Affairs
ai_summary: Lead regulatory strategy and execution for discovery and development programs, including the preparation and submission of INDs and CTAs. Manage interactions with the FDA and other global health authorities while partnering with cross-functional teams to ensure compliance.

title: Quality Control Inspector (Contractor)
ai_summary: The Quality Control Inspector ensures that incoming, in-process, and finished components meet quality standards through dimensional, visual, and functional inspections. They are responsible for documenting inspection reports, processing non-conforming issues, and maintaining equipment calibration.

title: Quality and Process Improvement Engineer
ai_summary: The role is responsible for maintaining the ISO 13485:2016 Quality Management System and leading cross-functional process improvement initiatives. Key duties include managing CAPA processes, conducting internal audits, and driving operational efficiency across quality and administrative workflows.

title: Regulatory Compliance Specialist
ai_summary: Manage the preparation and submission of regulatory documents to IRBs and IBCs to ensure timely trial start-ups. Maintain regulatory binders and coordinate with clinical research coordinators to ensure compliance with FDA and GCP requirements.

title: Senior Director, Regulatory Strategy – Global Regulatory Lead
ai_summary: The Senior Director leads integrated global regulatory strategies for immunology and inflammation programs, serving as the primary liaison with health authorities. They guide cross-functional teams through development planning, submission processes, and regulatory risk management to ensure global alignment.

title: Regulatory Affairs & Compliance Specialist II
company_name: University of Rochester Clinical and Translational Science Institute (UR CTSI)
ai_summary: The specialist manages regulatory submissions for clinical trials, specifically guiding investigators on FDA documentation and ensuring compliance with FDAAA Section 801. They are also responsible for administering the ClinicalTrials.gov registration and reporting program for the University of Rochester.

title: Director, Regulatory Operations
ai_summary: The Director of Regulatory Operations will establish the regulatory operations function, overseeing all deliverables including submission archives and the Veeva Vault RIM system. They will provide eCTD/CTD publishing services and coordinate major submissions like IND and BLA across various regulatory functions.

title: Senior Principal Regulatory Affairs Specialist
ai_summary: The role is responsible for developing and implementing global regulatory strategies and maintaining approvals for new and modified medical devices. This includes writing and filing regulatory submissions for the US and international markets while ensuring compliance of labeling and advertising.

title: Senior Regulatory Affairs Specialist
ai_summary: Lead regulatory remediation and QMS alignment to streamline global workflows and ensure compliance with FDA and ISO standards. Oversee global market expansion and regulatory strategy for AI-powered hardware and software platforms across multiple international territories.

title: QC Lab Administrator
ai_summary: The role focuses on routine laboratory systems maintenance, sample management, and ensuring compliance with GMP and corporate standards. Key duties include managing hazardous waste, overseeing contract laboratory activities, and maintaining laboratory inventory and documentation.
